Harvard Scholars Criticize Attacks on India's Institutions

Forty-four scholars from Harvard University have expressed concern over what they describe as a campaign against India's constitutional institutions. The scholars stated that dissent is a right, but undermining institutions is not. Their statement decries attacks on these institutions.
